name: Hissatsu! Sekika-chan
source:
--A revenge agent.
--A champion of the weak.
--If you post your troubles on social media with the hashtag '#Petrification-chan', she'll contact you via DM.

Even as an internet urban legend, it was an extremely obscure story with little credibility.
But 'I', who was being relentlessly bullied by the girls in my class, had no one else to turn to --

Petrification-chan carries out revenge after revenge, and 'I' am dragged into it.
Where will this revenge lead us at the end of it all --

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ335028.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
——复仇特工。
——弱者的冠军。
--如果你在社交媒体上使用主题标签“#Petrification-chan”发布你的烦恼，她会通过DM与你联系。

即使作为网络都市传说，这也是一个极其晦涩难懂的故事，可信度很低。
但被班上女生无情欺负的“我”却没有人可以求助——

石化酱展开一次又一次的复仇，‘我’也被卷入其中。
这场复仇最终会将我们带向何方——

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ335028.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
